messages:
leah: hi team, leah here (platform eng), first day! I'm stuck on Console access: Okta only shows 'Console (viewer)'. I need staging admin to validate infra flags and eventual prod access. who do i ping?

rachel: welcome leah :wave: For staging we normally add people to `console-admin-staging` via Okta request (self-serve). Prod `console-admin` is manager-approved + security review. if you don't see the staging group, open ENG-IT and tag @rachel.

omar: hey leah, i'm your manager. i'll approve prod once ENG-IT ticket is in. include which flags and an expiry (default 30 days for new hires).

leah: thanks Omar. what's the minimum ENG-IT body i should paste so it passes security review?

rachel: paste this exact body into ENG-IT: 

```
Request: console-admin-staging; console-admin-prod (prod gated)
Roles: flags-admin (LaunchDarkly)
Manager: Omar Khan
Justification: Validate infra flag behavior for migration of job-scheduler service
Flags: scheduler_enable_v2, scheduler_rollback_kill
Requested expiry: 2024-12-01
Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%; metrics: error_rate, p99 latency; rollback criteria: >1.5x error increase or sustained p99 > 2x baseline
```

ld-admin: also include your LaunchDarkly username in the ticket. We'll scope `flags-admin` to the specific projects you listed and set expiry. For new hires we auto-expire at 30 days unless manager requests extension.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: new hires must enable 2FA and register a YubiKey before prod admin is granted. Setup link: https://okta.redwood/setup-2fa

security-bot: Security note: prod admin grants are audited. Provide ticket number, least-privilege scope, and an explicit rollback plan for any flag that affects traffic. We'll run an access checklist post-approval.

leah: perfect, i'll open ENG-IT now and paste that. one quick question: how can I preview flags locally before toggling?

rachel: run the internal CLI `rdwctl flags preview <flag> --env=staging --whoami`. also check the console's flag history and add a short runbook to the ticket if you'll be changing multiple flags together.

leah: got it. thanks everyone! i'll ping @rachel and @omar once the ticket is up. :tada:
